mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it indicates a consumer-driven economic expansion, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% signals inflationary pressures, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over a quarter signals an economic contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
